citation: Li GW, Burkhardt D, Gross C, Weissman JS. Cell. 2014;157:624-635. doi:10.1016/j.cell.2014.02.033

checked.paper: Li, Burkhardt, Gross and Weissman, Cell 2014
checked.says: Size selection about 15-45 nt. Reads of 20-42 nt are mapped by giving the same length-weighted score to center residues at least 10 nt from either end. No single 5'-end offset.

Footprints 25-42 nt. Center residues at least 12 nt from either end share one score. The A site is the footprint center, validated at stop codons and stall sites. Not +15. The 2014 methods say the size selection differs from this procedure.

checked.paper: Ingolia, Ghaemmaghami, Newman and Weissman, Science 2009
checked.says: Fig. 2: 5' ends start 12-13 nt upstream of the start codon. Not an E. coli offset, and not a stated +15.

Density is assigned to the 3' end. MNase cuts about 12 nt from the A site. Harvest is flash-freezing and high Mg, not the filtration harvest of GSE53767. The 2019 Cell Systems citation does not exist; this is the 2019 E. coli paper.

checked.paper: Liu et al., Nucleic Acids Res. 2020 (RiboToolkit)
checked.says: Default codon analysis uses 26-32 nt reads. P-site offsets are supplied by the user or computed by plastid from the start-codon metagene. No E. coli offset for GSE53767.

checked.paper: Xiao et al., Nucleic Acids Res. 2018 (RiboCode)
checked.says: metaplots infers a length-specific P-site from the 5' end to annotated start codons. The worked examples are HEK293 (+12) and zebrafish, not GSE53767.

what_would_resolve: A primary source that states one A-site offset for GSE53767, or the authors' center-weighted rule applied to the reads of that accession. The GEO files were not reachable from this environment (ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov returned no response), so the reads were not reprocessed.
reason: epistasis.dwell_deviation was requested but the fitted dwell head is absent. No 5'-end A-site offset is stated for GSE53767. Li et al., Cell 2014, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2014.02.033, size-select about 15-45 nt and score the center residues at least 10 nt from either end of 20-42 nt reads. Li, Oh and Weissman, Nature 2012, doi:10.1038/nature10965, GSE35641, score center residues at least 12 nt from either end of 25-42 nt reads and do not state +15; the 2014 size selection is not that procedure. Ingolia et al., Science 2009, doi:10.1126/science.1168978, is yeast: 5' ends start 12-13 nt upstream of the start codon (Fig. 2). Mohammad, Green and Buskirk, eLife 2019, doi:10.7554/eLife.42591, assign their own 3' ends, about 12 nt from the A site, on a flash-freeze high-Mg library, not GSE53767. RiboToolkit (Nucleic Acids Res. 2020, doi:10.1093/nar/gkaa395) defaults to 26-32 nt and a user or plastid P-site. RiboCode (Nucleic Acids Res. 2018, doi:10.1093/nar/gky179) infers a P-site per read length and does not name GSE53767. The GEO files were not reachable. No dwell deviation of zero was substituted.
